observations: Photo 0 and Photo 1 show a stainless steel industrial grinder with a cylindrical body and a hinged lid secured by two metal clamps.
A blue label on the front of the machine clearly shows '2000A' and lists specifications: 220V, 3200RPM, 4100W, 2000g.
The machine has a grey metal base with a red power button and a blue handle or knob on the side.
A yellow 'Certificate of approval' sticker is attached to the lid.
The background shows cardboard boxes, suggesting a warehouse or storage setting.
The machine appears new or well-maintained, with no visible damage or wear.

claims.claim: 2000A Industrial Grinder is a 220V, 4.1 kW (4100W) high-speed machine running at 3200 RPM.
claims.evidence: The blue label in photo 0 and photo 1 clearly lists: 220V, 3200RPM, 4100W.

risks.risk: The machine may not be functional or may have internal damage not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A video showing the grinder operating, including the motor starting, grinding action, and sound.

risks.risk: The power supply or plug may not be compatible with Nigerian outlets (220V is standard, but plug type may differ).
risks.proof: Photo of the power cord and plug, showing the plug type and voltage rating.
risks.if_unproven: priced as incompatible or requiring adapter

risks.risk: The 'Certificate of approval' sticker may be fake or irrelevant to Nigerian standards.
risks.proof: Photo of the full certificate or official documentation verifying the approval.

proof_requests: Video of the grinder in operation.
Photo of the power cord and plug.
Photo of the full 'Certificate of approval' or any other official documentation.
response.reason: The model and key specifications are clearly visible and match the seller's claims. The item is identifiable as a 2000A industrial grinder. While there are hidden risks (functionality, plug compatibility, certification validity), these do not prevent pricing as the worst-case scenario (non-functional, incompatible, unverified) can be priced. The photos are sufficient to establish identity and basic claims.
